problem: On Windows, open(OUT,"w") without encoding uses the locale code page (commonly cp1252). The reports contain Unicode characters that cp1252 cannot encode.
fix: Explicit UTF-8 encoding for all text open() calls in the six existing source files, plus newline="\n" for text writes; report-equality tests were not weakened.
simulation: Linux sitecustomize.py forced cp1252 for make_level*.py .md writes when no encoding was supplied.
